questions.question: What is General American (GA)?
options: The accent perceived as neutral in the USA, typically used by national news broadcasters
The accent of New York City only
A British accent used in America
The official legal language of the USA
questions.explanation: General American is the variety perceived as "neutral" or "standard" in the US, commonly used by national broadcasters and in English teaching.

questions.question: Who is largely responsible for distinctive American spellings like "color" and "center"?
questions.explanation: Lexicographer Noah Webster promoted simplified spellings in his 1828 American Dictionary of the English Language, deliberately distinguishing American from British usage.

questions.question: When did Webster publish his famous American dictionary?
questions.explanation: Noah Webster published "An American Dictionary of the English Language" in 1828, codifying American spelling and usage.

questions.question: Why does American English dominate globally today?
options: The economic, technological, and cultural power of the United States
It is grammatically simpler than all other varieties
It is the oldest form of English
The United Nations made it official
questions.explanation: Hollywood, popular music, technology companies, and US economic power have made American English the most influential variety worldwide.

questions.question: Is American English linguistically uniform across the United States?
options: No - the US has many regional and social varieties, such as Southern English and African American English
No, because most Americans speak British English
questions.explanation: Despite the idea of a single "American accent", the US contains many regional and social varieties with distinct pronunciation and vocabulary.
